name: 屋外の公共の場所で喫煙を制限
summary: 現在は、市長が指定した喫煙禁止地区で喫煙を禁止しています。この議案では、道路や河川など条例で定める屋外の公共の場所でも、設置または設置を許可された喫煙場所を除いて喫煙を禁止します。また、市の責務に、市民や事業者と協力して分煙環境の整備を進めることを加えます。
changes: 市の責務に分煙環境の整備推進を加える
喫煙禁止地区を喫煙禁止重点地区に改める
条例で定める屋外の公共の場所で喫煙を禁止する
管理する人が設置または設置を許可した喫煙場所を禁止の対象外とする
who: 条例で定める屋外の公共の場所で喫煙する人
市が喫煙制限の対象に指定する場所を管理する人
why: 分煙環境の整備を進める市の責務を加え、喫煙を制限する屋外の公共の場所を定めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Restricts smoking in outdoor public places
en.official: Partial Amendment to the Yokohama City Ordinance on the Prevention of Scattering of Empty Cans, Cigarette Butts, etc.
en.summary: Smoking is currently prohibited in smoking-prohibition areas designated by the mayor. Under this bill, smoking will also be prohibited in outdoor public places specified by the ordinance, such as roads and rivers, except in smoking areas that have been installed or whose installation has been permitted. The bill also adds to the city's responsibilities promoting the development of an environment that separates smoking from non-smoking, in cooperation with residents and businesses.
changes: Adds promoting the development of smoking-separated environments to the city's responsibilities
Renames smoking-prohibition areas as priority smoking-prohibition areas
Prohibits smoking in outdoor public places specified by the ordinance
Exempts smoking areas installed or authorized by the person managing the location from the prohibition
who: People who smoke in outdoor public places specified by the ordinance
People who manage places designated by the city as subject to smoking restrictions
en.why: The city says this is to add to its responsibilities the promotion of an environment that separates smoking from non-smoking, and to specify outdoor public places where smoking is restricted.
